risk_if_not_implemented: Without Personnel Transfer to Alternate Processing / Storage Site, data, software and system images cannot be reliably restored within required recovery objectives following a disruption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Recovery Failure / Unacceptable Recovery Delay (R-OR-1), Loss of Critical Knowledge / Capability (R-PE-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Pandemic (Disease) Outbreaks (NT-7); Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Contingency Training
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to adequately train contingency personnel and applicable stakeholders in their contingency roles and responsibilities.
compensating_control_1.justification: Contingency Training (BCD-09) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Transfer to Alternate Processing / Storage Site (BCD-16.1) by reducing human-factor risk by equipping personnel to recognize and respond to relevant threats. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience Awareness Training
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to provide all employees and contractors appropriate security, compliance and resilience awareness education and training that is relevant for their job function.
compensating_control_2.justification: Security, Compliance & Resilience Awareness Training (SAT-04) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Transfer to Alternate Processing / Storage Site (BCD-16.1) by reducing human-factor risk by equipping personnel to recognize and respond to relevant threats. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
